deepseek.latest_evolution: Launched as a successor to V3 in April 2026, introducing Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and FP4 quantization-aware training. It represents the latest flagship evolution in the DeepSeek series.

versions_timeline.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro Flagship Trillion-Scale MoE Model

gemopus.latest_evolution: The project evolved from an initial release to a 'stability-first' variant with APEX (Adaptive Precision for EXpert Models) quantization. While still maintained as an engineering reference, the developer has since shifted focus to the Qwopus-3.5 series for production-grade performance.

versions_timeline.title: Gemopus-4-26B Large Language Model

tinymu.latest_evolution: Accepted by ICASSP 2026 and publicly released in April 2026, TinyMU proves that high-quality supervision and specialized encoders can replace massive parameter scale. The research evolved into fine-grained pre-training with FineLAP and MeanAudio later in 2026.

versions_timeline.title: TinyMU: Compact Audio-Language Model for Music Understanding

connect-the-dots.latest_evolution: Transitioned from an experimental utility to a stable full release in April 2026. Major updates introduced 'Lasers' visual highlighting for active connections and an automatic canvas jump feature for quick node verification.

versions_timeline.title: ConnectTheDots: Sidebar Node Connection Tool for ComfyUI

rawgen.latest_evolution: Officially released in early 2026 as a first-of-its-kind unified raw generation framework. It is currently being integrated into Samsung's neural ISP and AI Experience (AX) roadmaps for future mobile photography.

versions_timeline.title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation

pytheory.latest_evolution: The project culminated in the release of 'Interpretations', a 24-track album rendered entirely via Python scripts. It has expanded to support complex microtonal tuning systems and real-time algorithmic generation.

versions_timeline.title: NumPy as Synth Engine (PyTheory)

wilddet3d.latest_evolution: Launched in April 2026 with inference code and model weights; expanded in late April 2026 with full training code and the massive WildDet3D-Data dataset containing over 1 million images. A companion iPhone app for real-time on-device 3D detection was also released.

versions_timeline.title: WildDet3D: Scaling Promptable 3D Detection in the Wild

motif-video.latest_evolution: Integrated into Hugging Face Diffusers shortly after launch, the model has seen widespread adoption due to its native support and GGUF quantization for consumer hardware.

versions_timeline.title: Motif-Video 2B: Efficient Decoupled Diffusion Transformer Video Model

dreamlite.latest_evolution: The inference code was released in April 2026 via the ByteVisionLab GitHub organization. The model currently achieves real-time performance on smartphones through 4-step distillation and a pruned mobile U-Net backbone.

versions_timeline.title: DreamLite: Unified On-Device Image Generation and Editing

cdm.latest_evolution: Since its introduction, CDM has been used to distill 'Turbo' versions of popular models like Stable Diffusion 3 Medium and Longcat Image, which are actively maintained and available on Hugging Face. These models achieve high-quality results in just 4 steps, matching or surpassing 100-step teacher models.

versions_timeline.title: CDM: Continuous-Time Distribution Matching Diffusion Distillation

rs-nodes.latest_evolution: The project evolved from a utility node collection into a comprehensive training ecosystem for LTX-Video, introducing conditioning-safe LoRAs and integration with MOSS-TTS for synchronized audio-video workflows.

versions_timeline.title: RS Nodes: ComfyUI LoRA Training for Video

modddif.latest_evolution: Has transitioned from a basic texturing tool into a specialized refinement suite for 3D artists. Recent major updates include multi-view consistency support, targeted texture in-painting for specific mesh areas, and automated PBR segmentation.

versions_timeline.title: Modddif — AI 3D Model Texturing and Refinement Toolkit

habitat-gs.latest_evolution: Officially released in April 2026 with 65 high-quality scenes. As of May 2026, it has been updated with interactive Gaussian scenes and an LLM-powered HabitatAgent demo that supports natural language navigation.

versions_timeline.title: Habitat-GS: Gaussian Splatting Simulator for Robot Navigation

unify-agent.latest_evolution: The project evolved from a static diffusion-based model into a fully autonomous agentic system in early 2026. It now features an optimized pipeline that autonomously identifies knowledge gaps in prompts and acquires real-world visual evidence via web-search grounding before synthesis.

versions_timeline.title: Unify-Agent: Open-Book Agentic Image Synthesis

gaussian-splatting.latest_evolution: Evolved from static 3DGS (2023) and fixed-interval 4DGS (2024) into an adaptive densification model presented at Eurographics 2026. It replaces rigid temporal intervals with motion-aware refinement, significantly improving performance on stochastic dynamic scenes.

versions_timeline.title: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal 3D Gaussian Splatting

sync-labs.latest_evolution: Following the academic success of Wav2Lip, Sync Labs released Lipsync-2 in 2024 and the flagship Sync-3 in April 2026. The latest version features native 4K super-resolution, obstruction detection, and a global scene understanding model.

versions_timeline.title: Sync-3: Professional AI Lip-Sync by Sync Labs

aose.latest_evolution: Transitioned from a research prototype to a production-ready local service with MCP integration. It now supports major agent platforms like Claude Code and Gemini CLI, offering deep traceability for agent-made edits.

versions_timeline.title: AgentOfficeSuite (AOSE) — Collaborative Office Suite for Humans and AI Agents

gems.latest_evolution: The project introduced inference-time scaling for multimodal models and a modular 'Skill' system, allowing smaller models to outperform larger proprietary ones like GPT-Image.

versions_timeline.title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory

joyai-image.latest_evolution: Released official ComfyUI and Diffusers library support in April 2026. Published a comprehensive technical report and the OpenSpatial-3M dataset in May 2026 to facilitate research into spatially-aware image editing and camera control.

versions_timeline.title: JoyAI-Image: Unified Multimodal Foundation Model

cointeract.latest_evolution: Following its April 2026 launch, the project added pre-trained checkpoints, training guidelines, and a pose-driven inference module for advanced motion control.

versions_timeline.title: CoInteract: Interactive Human-Object Video Generation

pruna-ai.latest_evolution: The model is now integrated into the Pruna Performance Suite alongside P-Image and P-Image-Edit, supporting up to 1080p resolution and real-time API access. It has been optimized for sub-2-second inference times.

versions_timeline.title: P-Video-Avatar: High-Speed AI Talking-Head Animation

prompt-relay.latest_evolution: Originally a research implementation, Prompt-Relay has become a standard utility integrated into the Wan 2.2 and LTX 2.3 ecosystems. It is now a core component of the LTX Director timeline editor and various ComfyUI nodes for multi-event storytelling.

versions_timeline.title: Prompt Relay: Inference-Time Temporal Control for Video

gemini.latest_evolution: Evolved from the 1.5 series into a performance-driven architecture that ignores traditional SSML in favor of intuitive scene-based descriptions. It marks a shift towards contextual vocal mastery and enterprise-grade scalability.

versions_timeline.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS High-Precision Speech Control

voxcpm.latest_evolution: Released as a major successor to VoxCPM 1.5, moving to a continuous-representation pipeline that produces studio-quality 48kHz audio. It introduced 'Voice Design' for creating voices from text descriptions and significantly improved speaker similarity scores over commercial competitors.

versions_timeline.title: VoxCPM2 — 2B Tokenizer-Free Multilingual TTS and Voice Cloning

trellis.latest_evolution: TRELLIS.2 succeeded the original 2B parameter version, introducing Omni-Voxels (O-Voxels) and full Physically Based Rendering (PBR) support. It expanded resolution capabilities and improved geometric accuracy for non-manifold surfaces.

versions_timeline.title: TRELLIS.2: High-Fidelity 3D Generation on Mac

sync-so.latest_evolution: The platform has evolved from legacy GAN-based models to the diffusion-based Lipsync-2 and the current Sync-3 flagship. Sync-3 introduces native 4K processing, advanced obstruction detection, and full-shot visual dubbing that maintains skin textures and lighting consistency.

versions_timeline.title: Sync.so AI Visual Dubbing and Lip-Sync Studio

odyssey.latest_evolution: Evolved from video generation to a 'physical intelligence' engine; Odyssey-2 Max scales parameters 3x over Odyssey-2 Pro and utilizes NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. It is currently in private beta for robotics and defense partners.

versions_timeline.title: Odyssey-2 Max: Real-time Generative World Simulator

longcat-audiodit.latest_evolution: The project evolved from a research prototype to a production-ready model suite including 3.5B and 1B variants. It introduced Adaptive Projection Guidance (APG) and gained full integration into the ComfyUI ecosystem.

versions_timeline.title: LongCat-AudioDiT: High-Fidelity Waveform Latent Diffusion TTS

vista4d.latest_evolution: Selected as a CVPR 2026 Highlight, Vista4D was released in April 2026 with open-source inference code and model weights (384p and 720p). It utilizes the Wan2.1-T2V-14B base model and is currently part of Netflix’s AI-driven filmmaking roadmap.

versions_timeline.title: Vista4D: Netflix Framework for 4D Video Reshooting

psdesigner.latest_evolution: The project introduced CreativePSD, the first large-scale Photoshop-based dataset with operation traces. It moved beyond black-box generation to a modular architecture (AssetCollector, GraphicPlanner, ToolExecutor) and was accepted to CVPR 2026.

versions_timeline.title: PSDesigner: Automated Graphic Design with Human-Like Workflow

obscura-remova.latest_evolution: Evolved into a requested standard feature for integration into major video generation pipelines like Wan2GP. The model has transitioned from simple foreground removal to complex full-background reconstruction tasks.

versions_timeline.title: Obscura Remova LTX23 Video-to-Video LoRA

girl-agent.latest_evolution: The project introduced Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, Docker support, and a streamlined CLI installation process. Recent updates focus on complex emotional modeling through specific counters for trust, attraction, and irritation.

versions_timeline.title: girl-agent: Personality-First Telegram AI Persona Engine

mf0-1984.latest_evolution: The project transitioned from a memory-focused framework to a comprehensive 'Digital Partner' ecosystem with 3D memory visualization and autonomous workflow orchestration.

versions_timeline.title: MF0-1984: Long-Term Memory for Multimodal AI Agents

zveroboy-photo.latest_evolution: Transitioned from simple noise-addition tools to a sophisticated engine for RAW/DNG workflows, including authentic sensor noise modeling (Shot and Read noise) and professional camera metadata presets.

versions_timeline.title: ComfyUI-zveroboy-photo for RAW Workflow and Photorealism

minimax-music.latest_evolution: The 2.6 update introduced a headline AI Cover feature, precise BPM and key controls, and reduced generation latency to under 20 seconds. It also launched open-source MusicSkill modules to integrate music generation into AI agent ecosystems.

versions_timeline.title: MiniMax Music 2.6 AI Music Generation Platform

hy-mt.latest_evolution: Updated in mid-2026 with 1.25-bit quantization via the Sherry framework, reducing the 1.8B model to 440MB for deployment on low-end mobile hardware. It is currently the industry benchmark for offline on-device translation.

versions_timeline.title: Tencent Hy-MT1.5 Mobile Machine Translation

vanast.latest_evolution: Selected as a CVPR 2026 Highlight, the project formally launched in April 2026. It represents a major shift from disjointed two-stage pipelines to a unified diffusion-based architecture, with public inference code and weights released in May 2026.

versions_timeline.title: Vanast: Unified Human Animation and Virtual Try-On

numina.latest_evolution: Released as a trending research framework on ArXiv (ID: 2604.08546) in April 2026; currently being integrated as a plug-and-play module for models like OpenSora and Wan2.1.

versions_timeline.title: NUMINA: Numerical Alignment for Video Diffusion

mirofish.latest_evolution: The project reached 60,000 GitHub stars in early 2026, introducing the OASIS framework for scaling simulations to millions of agents and integrating GraphRAG for grounded entity memory. A community-led MiroFish-Offline version was launched for local execution.

versions_timeline.title: MiroFish: Open-Source Multi-Agent Social Behavior Simulation Engine

storysplat.latest_evolution: After the v2.0 rebuild on PlayCanvas, the platform introduced SOG compression and LOD streaming. Newer updates in v2.2 and v2.3 added Image-to-Splat generation, 3D measurement tools, and an embeddable NPM viewer, while requiring legacy scenes to be re-exported for compatibility.

versions_timeline.title: StorySplat v2.3: Interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting Editor

unity-ai.latest_evolution: Transitioned from beta to core production-ready status in Unity 6. Muse has added video-to-motion and text-to-motion capabilities, while Sentis now supports native PyTorch and LiteRT model imports without conversion as of 2026.

versions_timeline.title: Unity AI (Muse & Sentis) for Unity 6

m-xr.latest_evolution: The project transitioned from a capture service into the I2M foundational model and API. It is now integrated into the Marso Studio platform, focusing on automated PBR generation and retexturing of photogrammetry assets.

versions_timeline.title: M-XR Image-to-Material Production PBR Generation

sana.latest_evolution: The project expanded from SANA (text-to-image) to SANA-Video, followed by SANA-WM, a 2.6B parameter world model supporting 1-minute 720p video with 6-DoF camera control.

versions_timeline.title: SANA-Video: Efficient 720p Video Synthesis and Upscaling

cadd.latest_evolution: Presented at ICLR 2026, the project evolved from Apple's previous DiffuCoder research. The official ml-cadd repository and model checkpoints were released in late April 2026, marking its transition to a stable, reproducible research platform.

versions_timeline.title: CADD-Base-7B: Apple’s Masked Diffusion Model for Code Generation

daybreak.latest_evolution: Launched in May 2026, the project is transitioning from simple vulnerability scanning to autonomous patching through its Codex Security agentic harness. It is currently in a controlled rollout phase with key industry partners like Cloudflare and Cisco.

versions_timeline.title: OpenAI Daybreak

triattention.latest_evolution: After its April 2026 release, the project was ported to llama.cpp (triattention-ggml) and integrated into SGLang. It currently supports AMD/ROCm and NVIDIA Blackwell architectures, often serving as a standard component for local reasoning model stacks alongside quantization tools.

versions_timeline.title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning via Trigonometric KV Compression

lava-music.latest_evolution: Transitioned from smart acoustic guitars to a fully digital, stringless platform with the Genie launch in late 2024. The ecosystem now centers on the LAVA+ app's AI song decoding capabilities and modular hardware expansion.

versions_timeline.title: LAVA Genie: AI-Integrated Stringless Smart Guitar

copaw.latest_evolution: Evolved from basic tool-calling LLMs into a fully autonomous 'agentic' framework within the QwenPaw ecosystem, capable of multi-step task execution and self-correction without human prompts.

versions_timeline.title: CoPaw-Flash-9B: Autonomous Data Analyst Agent

seed.latest_evolution: Evolved from Seed3D 1.0 by transitioning to a two-stage DiT pipeline and MoE-based material engine. It added support for URDF export for robotics simulation, functional part decomposition, and scene-level generation capabilities.

versions_timeline.title: Seed3D 2.0: ByteDance's Production-Ready 3D Foundation Model

gen-searcher.latest_evolution: The project evolved from Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to Agentic Reinforcement Learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with dual reward feedback. It introduced KnowGen, a specialized benchmark for search-grounded image generation.

versions_timeline.title: Gen-Searcher: Search-Grounded Multimodal Deep Research Agent

lumipic.latest_evolution: Adapted from LumiVid research for single-image reconstruction, the project has expanded to support large-scale DiT models. It currently offers production-ready LoRAs for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and experimental support for the faster FLUX.2-klein architecture.

versions_timeline.title: LumiPic SDR-to-HDR Image Diffusion

gbrain.latest_evolution: GBrain evolved rapidly after its April 2026 launch, introducing an autonomous 'Dream Cycle' for background memory maintenance and deduplication. It now incorporates BrainBench-Real for retrieval evaluation and serves as the primary memory runtime for the OpenClaw and Hermes agent architectures.

versions_timeline.title: GBrain Memory Layer for OpenClaw and Hermes Agents

griptape.latest_evolution: Acquired by Foundry in February 2026. The project evolved from a general-purpose Python AI agent framework into the core infrastructure layer for Foundry's AI-first VFX strategy and Nuke integration.

versions_timeline.title: Griptape AI Orchestration Platform for VFX

phi.latest_evolution: Evolved from the Phi-Ground-4B-7C research model into an official Microsoft project integrated into Windows Copilot's 'Vision Highlighting'. The current 'Any' version features improved robustness for 4K screens and high-resolution UI interaction.

versions_timeline.title: Phi-Ground-Any: Microsoft GUI Grounding Multimodal Model

physforge.latest_evolution: Accepted to ICML 2026. The project is currently transitioning to open-source with the release of the PhysDB dataset containing 150,000 physically annotated assets.

versions_timeline.title: PhysForge: Physically Grounded Interactive 3D Asset Generation

gsd.latest_evolution: Transitioned from a legacy prompt framework to a standalone supervisor-level CLI built on the Pi SDK. Recent updates added state reconciliation, drift detection, and automated workspace lifecycle management.

versions_timeline.title: GSD 2: Autonomous CLI Agent for Software Engineering

openreview.latest_evolution: Transitioned from an internal Vercel tool to a public open-source project; currently utilizes Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Vercel Sandbox for high-fidelity code analysis and direct PR fixes.

versions_timeline.title: OpenReview: AI-Powered Code Review Bot by Vercel Labs

rodin.latest_evolution: Following the 10B-parameter BANG architecture release in late 2025 (Gen 2), the 2.5 update introduces ultra-detailed surface sculpting and 'Smart Low-Poly' export features with automated normal map baking.

versions_timeline.title: Rodin Gen 2.5 (Hyper3D)

comphairhead.latest_evolution: Released in April 2026 as a successor to 3DGH, introducing Position-Based Dynamics (PBD) for hair simulation within a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework. It remains the current state-of-the-art for physically realistic, one-shot avatar animation.

versions_timeline.title: CompHairHead: One-shot 3D Avatars with Deformable Hair

moss-tts.latest_evolution: Launched in April 2026 as a 100M parameter model; later received ONNX optimizations for CPU performance and MLX support for Apple Silicon. MOSS-TTS 2.0 was announced in May 2026 to incorporate community feedback.

versions_timeline.title: MOSS-TTS-Nano

sdxs.latest_evolution: The project evolved into an Alpha version in April 2026, introducing a 1.6B parameter UNet and Qwen3.5 text encoder. It now features an integrated 2x upscaling capability via a 32-channel asymmetric VAE decoder.

versions_timeline.title: SDXS-1B: Real-Time Diffusion and High-Fidelity Upscaler

gameworld.latest_evolution: Evolved from the 'Gameworld 10k' research benchmark by VERSES AI into a community-driven platform under the gameworld-project organization in April 2026, expanding from 10 to 34 games.

versions_timeline.title: GameWorld: Standardized Platform for Multimodal AI Agent Evaluation

phoneclaw.latest_evolution: Evolved into a comprehensive local agent in 2026 with the release of Gemma 4, adding Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for 37% faster inference and deep integration with iOS HealthKit and Contacts.

versions_timeline.title: PhoneClaw: Local Gemma 4 On-Device Agent for iOS

spatial-studio.latest_evolution: Evolved from a beta capture tool into a unified spatial engine with integrated AI automation. Current iterations feature Spatial Sense AI for scene analysis and LOD streaming to enable high-fidelity 3DGS on mobile browsers.

versions_timeline.title: Spatial Studio 3D Gaussian Splatting by Real Horizons

lingbot-map.latest_evolution: Launched by Ant Group's Robbyant division in mid-April 2026. Rapidly updated with FlashInfer KV cache optimizations for long sequences and hardware acceleration enabling 20 FPS real-time performance. A 25,000-frame indoor walkthrough demo was released in late April to demonstrate long-term stability.

versions_timeline.title: LingBot-Map Real-time Streaming 3D Scene Reconstruction

elevenlabs.latest_evolution: Shifted from a cloud-only API model to supporting Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on AWS and Google Cloud, followed by the introduction of true on-premise and on-device (offline) deployments. These local versions utilize confidential computing to ensure data remains isolated and encrypted during processing.

versions_timeline.title: ElevenLabs: On-Premise and On-Device Speech AI Deployment

comfyui-6dof.latest_evolution: The project evolved from basic projection nodes into a complete 3D scene-editing suite. Significant updates introduced an interactive Three.js viewer, a poseable IK mannequin (Character Placer) for ControlNet-ready skeletons, and integration with video models like Wan2.1 for camera path animation.

versions_timeline.title: ComfyUI 6DOF Camera — 3D Scene Manipulation & Character Staging

svgs.latest_evolution: Following the original release in November 2024, the concept of spatially varying Gaussians has been extended to inverse rendering with the SVG-IR project, which was accepted to CVPR 2025. The core SVGS implementation remains the foundational work for expressive Gaussian primitives.

versions_timeline.title: SVGS: Spatially Varying Gaussian Splatting for Scene Reconstruction

coral.latest_evolution: Originally a 2025 project focused on collaborative reasoning between LLMs, it evolved in early 2026 into an autonomous research platform. It now supports 'spontaneous organization' where agents form alliances and self-refine their collaborative structures to solve complex engineering and mathematical tasks.

versions_timeline.title: CORAL: Infrastructure for Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution

claude-code.latest_evolution: Originally a basic FastAPI proxy for NVIDIA NIM, it evolved into a multi-provider gateway with a local admin UI and intelligent routing. It now supports the Claude Dev VSCode extension and JetBrains IDEs, moving from a 'free' hack to a robust backend-agnostic tool for the Claude ecosystem.

versions_timeline.title: Free Claude Code: AI Proxy for Claude CLI

tribe.latest_evolution: Based on Meta's TRansformative Inference for Behavioral Evaluation (TRIBE) v2 framework; the tool includes local Whisper transcription and Ollama-based editing recommendations for creative strategy.

versions_timeline.title: TRIBE Review MVP

sillytavern.latest_evolution: Transitioned into a comprehensive 'AI Roleplay Console' with integrated RAG, live 2D expressions, and native support for multimodal reasoning models like DeepSeek v4 and Claude 4.7. Recent updates focus on interleaved thinking for complex tool-calling and enhanced security against SSRF attacks.

versions_timeline.title: SillyTavern: Advanced AI Roleplay Interface

icecache.latest_evolution: Presented at ICLR 2026, IceCache represents the current frontier in semantic-aware KV-cache management. It extends the PagedAttention concept by adding a DCI-tree based hierarchical index for query-aware token retrieval.

versions_timeline.title: IceCache: Memory-Efficient Semantic KV-Cache for Long LLMs

lgtm.latest_evolution: Following its initial publication, the official code and weights were released under Apple's machine learning repository in early 2026. It has since been adopted as a plug-and-play high-resolution rendering module for generalizable backbones like NoPoSplat and DepthSplat.

versions_timeline.title: LGTM: Less Gaussians, Texture More for 3D Reconstruction

playcoder.latest_evolution: Transitioned from an early research prototype to a comprehensive multi-agent system including PlayDeveloper, PlayRefiner, and PlayTester components. It was featured at FSE 2026 as a major advancement in automated program repair for GUIs.

versions_timeline.title: PlayCoder: Making LLM-Generated GUI Code Playable

majoor.latest_evolution: Transitioned from a WIP survival tool in late 2024 to a production-ready suite by early 2026. The v2.0 refactor introduced a detached floating viewer (MFV), backend/frontend separation, and optimized SQLite indexing for massive asset collections.

versions_timeline.title: Majoor Assets Manager for ComfyUI

open-design.latest_evolution: Since its launch, the project has evolved from basic agent adapters to a sophisticated platform featuring cross-session memory and the 'Critique Theater' replay system. Major updates added support for a wide range of agents including Devin, DeepSeek, and Mistral, along with a visual gallery for artifact management.

versions_timeline.title: Open Design: Local-First Open Source AI Design Engine
